description: This header file provides C++ wrapper classes and utilities for Android binder objects, including smart pointers for AIBinder, AParcel, AStatus, and file descriptors, as well as RAII management and helper functions.

classes.name: SpAIBinder
classes.description: Smart pointer managing strong references to AIBinder objects.

classes.name: ScopedAResource
classes.description: Template base class for RAII management of Android binder resources.

classes.name: ScopedAStatus
classes.description: RAII wrapper for AStatus objects, with convenience methods.

classes.name: ScopedAIBinder_Weak
classes.description: RAII wrapper for AIBinder_Weak objects, with promote method.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for SpAIBinder, manages reference counting.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the internal AIBinder pointer, managing reference counts.

methods.name: getR
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal AIBinder* for modification.

methods.name: closeWithError
methods.description: Closes a file descriptor with error logging.
